Your neighbors bank here.

Calder Credit Union has served Port Calder since 1952. We now have a branch on 4th Street in Eastfield. Free mints included.

Accounts, the new branch, and a little of the history are on this site.

Calder Credit Union has been a Port Calder institution since 1952.

We are a credit union, not a high-street bank with another city's name on the door. Members belong to the place they live.

The 4th Street branch is the newest room we have opened.

Our Eastfield branch is on 4th Street. There are two counters and a small waiting area.

If you are already a member, you can use this branch as well as the others. If you are not, ask at the desk.

Free mints are in the glass bowl, not in the window.

We offer everyday accounts, savings, and a youth account.

Rates change, and the ones that apply to you are the ones we print for you at the desk. This page is not an offer.

Calder Credit Union, 4th Street, Eastfield, and our other Port Calder counters.

Telephone the desk during opening hours. The form on this page does not send a message.
